comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Asset-light two-sided online marketplace earning take-rate fees from consumers and providers, though for home services rather than lodging.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Owns upscale hotels and resorts as a real-estate asset operator, unlike Airbnb's asset-light marketplace with no owned lodging.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: B2B travel distribution and airline IT software sold to suppliers and agencies, not a consumer-facing lodging marketplace.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Lodging REIT owning select-service hotels; capital-intensive property ownership differs from Airbnb's commission-based platform.
